permanent_residency_pathways.ethiopianEligibilityNotes: Open to all nationalities including Ethiopian citizens applying from outside Canada via Express Entry or PNP, subject to CRS score, ECA credential evaluation, proof of funds, and biometrics.
permanent_residency_pathways.educationRequirement: Educational Credential Assessment (ECA) equivalent to Canadian secondary/Bachelor's/Master's degree.
permanent_residency_pathways.experienceRequirement: Minimum 1 year of continuous full-time skilled work experience (TEER 0, 1, 2, or 3) within the last 10 years.
permanent_residency_pathways.languageRequirement: English (IELTS General / CELPIP / PTE Core — minimum CLB 7 for FSWP) and/or French (TEF / TCF Canada — major CRS bonus).
permanent_residency_pathways.ageRestriction: No hard upper age bar, but CRS age points peak at ages 20–29 and decrease progressively after age 30.
permanent_residency_pathways.skillsAssessmentRequired: Educational Credential Assessment (WES, ICAS, IQAS, etc.) required for foreign degrees; licensing required for regulated trades/engineering/healthcare.
permanent_residency_pathways.permanentResidencyRoute: Direct Permanent Residence granted upon Invitation to Apply (ITA) and IRCC approval; citizenship eligible after 3 years (1,095 days) physical presence.
permanent_residency_pathways.employerSponsorshipOptions: LMIA-backed job offer or Provincial Nomination (+600 CRS points) accelerates selection, though FSWP does not strictly require a job offer.
permanent_residency_pathways.familyRelocationOptions: Spouse/common-law partner and dependent children under 22 included on the same PR application with full work and study rights.
permanent_residency_pathways.governmentApplicationFees: Verify current IRCC fees on canada.ca (approx. CAD $1,525 per principal applicant including Right of Permanent Residence Fee; biometrics CAD $85).

permanent_residency_pathways.ethiopianEligibilityNotes: Open to offshore applicants worldwide including Ethiopian citizens who hold a positive skills assessment for an eligible occupation and receive a SkillSelect invitation.
permanent_residency_pathways.educationRequirement: Relevant Bachelor's/Master's degree or recognized trade qualification assessed by an Australian assessing authority.
permanent_residency_pathways.experienceRequirement: Typically 1–8+ years of closely related skilled employment for competitive SkillSelect points.
permanent_residency_pathways.languageRequirement: Minimum Competent English (IELTS 6.0 each band or PTE equivalent); Proficient/Superior English adds +10 to +20 points.
permanent_residency_pathways.ageRestriction: Must be under 45 years of age at the time of receiving an Invitation to Apply (ITA).
permanent_residency_pathways.skillsAssessmentRequired: Mandatory positive Skills Assessment (e.g., CPA Australia / CA ANZ / IPA for accounting, Engineers Australia for civil/water engineers, VETASSESS for general professions).
permanent_residency_pathways.permanentResidencyRoute: Subclass 189 and 190 grant direct Permanent Residency on approval; Subclass 491 leads to PR (Subclass 191) after 3 years living/working in regional Australia.
permanent_residency_pathways.employerSponsorshipOptions: Skills in Demand (Subclass 482) employer-sponsored work visa also provides a Transition Stream to PR (Subclass 186) after 2 years.
permanent_residency_pathways.familyRelocationOptions: Partner and dependent children can be included on the same visa with full work and school access.
permanent_residency_pathways.governmentApplicationFees: Verify current Home Affairs Visa Pricing Table on immi.homeaffairs.gov.au (base charge starts ~AUD $4,770 for principal applicant).

permanent_residency_pathways.educationRequirement: Eligible occupation at RQF Level 3 (A-level equivalent) or higher; degree required for regulated finance/engineering roles.
permanent_residency_pathways.experienceRequirement: Depends on employer role and meeting the official going-rate salary threshold (standard £38,700 or discounted Immigration Salary List / New Entrant rate).

permanent_residency_pathways.educationRequirement: Recognized university degree (checked via Anabin / ZAB) for EU Blue Card, or 2-year recognized vocational training for §18a.
permanent_residency_pathways.experienceRequirement: Employment contract meeting Blue Card salary threshold (lower bottleneck threshold applies to engineering, IT, and healthcare).
permanent_residency_pathways.languageRequirement: English accepted for many EU Blue Card jobs in finance/IT/engineering; German B1 shortens EU Blue Card settlement permit to 21 months (27 months with A1).

permanent_residency_pathways.skillsAssessmentRequired: Degree comparability check in Anabin database or Statement of Comparability from ZAB; vocational recognition (Anerkennung) for skilled trades.

permanent_residency_pathways.employerSponsorshipOptions: Requires a binding German employment contract; Chancenkarte allows up to 1 year job search in Germany with points.
permanent_residency_pathways.familyRelocationOptions: Spouse and minor children receive residence permits; EU Blue Card spouses are exempt from pre-entry German language proof and get unrestricted work access.
permanent_residency_pathways.governmentApplicationFees: Verify on make-it-in-germany.com (National Visa EUR €75; residence card ~EUR €100; ZAB evaluation ~EUR €208).
